title: krookie's structures
description:
This mod adds different stuff that can change your gameplay.
It adds 5 new structures, a completely new material with its own unique armour set and tools. and its the strongest material.
body:
This mod is specifically for the people who want more stuff to enhance their gameplay. It adds things like new tools, armour and structures. it can give you those stuff, as it adds:
- A completely new material, found only in the end, called Ender Gem. It behaves similarly to ancient debris, since you need a smithing template to craft its own unique, corresponding armour set, which can also be traded by villagers.
- 5 New and unique structures, which can help you early game. And the structures are:
### An abandoned house
_Once bustling with player activity, has been left abandoned, and is now open for you to loot._
  
### An abandoned farm
_used by the pillagers when low on food, also left abandoned, with crops still growing, which can be picked up and used as early game food._
  
### A small desert temple
_its easily detectable due to the smoke coming out of it, and it also has loot!_

### A end torch
_it spawns in the end, and in the overworld. It's probably the most overpowered structure yet, as it can provide really good loot._
 
### Sculk outbreak 
_an outbreak of sculk caused by something unknown. Be careful not to kill any mobs near it, since the sculk catalysts will make sure it spreads. It's basically a mini deep dark, but not in a cave._

- 3 New achievements.
- And way more features to come in the future!
